object_description: two compact building volumes linked by a basement
design_condition: The compact wings occupy opposite sides of the elongated plot, forming a nearly square street-facing open space and a tree-lined courtyard with a rear connection, while the sports wing responds to the adjacent park edge and matches the school wing's height.

positive.statement: The urban development setting combines an interesting addition and natural connection of public urban spaces with the school's high usage requirements.

position.target: public urban spaces and school setting
position.rationale: The street-facing opening between the compact wings is clearly visible in plan.

positive.statement: The urban development strategy is reflected in the clever continuation of use units, allowing the school and the city to form a spatial composition.

position.rationale: One compact wing anchors the spatial composition formed by the paired building volumes.

positive.statement: The space between the two buildings provides a generous access situation and clear addressing of the entrances.

position.target: space between the two buildings and entrances
position.rationale: The central access space and opposing entrance edges are legible across the views.

positive.statement: The tree-lined courtyard and the shared areas provide useful common spaces for school operations.

position.rationale: The rear courtyard zone is visible between the opposite compact wings.

positive.statement: The ground floor can be used very flexibly and efficiently through the overlap of multipurpose use and the entrance hall.

position.rationale: The ground-level central access zone approximates the entrance hall and multipurpose overlap.

positive.statement: The efficient floor plan concept and the clear arrangement of the outside space are convincing from an operational point of view.

position.rationale: The open spaces around and between the wings are clearly represented in plan.

positive.statement: The two buildings impress with good construction values, compactness, resource-saving durability, and a sensible ventilation concept.

position.target: compact building parts and ventilation concept
position.rationale: The compact paired massing is visible, while ventilation remains a broad building-level judgment.

positive.statement: The different support structures are reflected in a finely graduated architectural expression of the facades.

position.rationale: Facade articulation and differing structural expressions are visible on the perimeter elevations.

positive.statement: The vertically consistent static concept of the compact building parts is economical.

position.rationale: Stacked, compact building geometry is evident through the repeated elevation levels.

negative.statement: The reduced access and compact floor formation are restrictive on the upper floors because the central zones are occupied.

position.rationale: The upper-level restriction is anchored within a wing at the elevated central zone.

negative.statement: The classrooms positioned across the façade are unfavorable in their organization and lighting.

position.rationale: Classroom interiors are not distinguishable, so the facade-side upper zone is used.

negative.statement: The strong building grid limits the flexibility of use.

position.rationale: Repeated regular point patterns visibly support a grid-system anchor.

negative.statement: The internal spaciousness on the upper floors is weakened by the central usage arrangements and loses quality.

position.rationale: The upper central zone of the opposite wing provides a distributed floor-level estimate.

negative.statement: The typological approach of separate access areas with a shared center of use contradicts the horizontal flexibility requirements of a vocational school.

position.target: separate access areas and shared center
position.rationale: The central connection is visible, but internal access-area divisions are not directly resolved.

negative.statement: The two narrow connecting corridors are poorly usable, leaving the solution indecisive on the upper floors.

position.rationale: Connecting circulation is approximated at the central link between the two wings.

negative.statement: The mentioned pile foundation is cost-intensive.

position.rationale: The foundation cost judgment has no useful visible spatial referent in the exterior point cloud.
